# HIGH-ALERT INDEX — political-risk-flagged content

**Auto-generated by `build_data.py` on every run. Do NOT hand-edit.**

This file lists every NODE and every EDGE in the vault that carries
`political-risk-flag: true` — content with documented real-world
harm-wiring per CODEX v1.2 §IV.5 (ethno-nationalist reception,
antisemitic networks, racial-hierarchy mobilization).

The political-risk-flag is **orthogonal to tier**. A T1 mainstream-
academic claim about a politically-dangerous movement gets the flag
if the *content* is harm-wired, even though the *source* is mainstream.

## Triage usage

- **John**: `cat 00_meta/HIGH-ALERT-INDEX.md` for the full danger list.
  Decide which entries to surface / restrict / remove. Re-tier or
  un-flag a node by editing its YAML; the next `python3 build_data.py`
  refreshes this file.
- **Agents**: must read this file BEFORE greenlighting a release,
  approving any T4/T5 batch, or wiring any new edge that touches a
  node already on the index (per CODEX §VI rule 9).
